renders.title: Remaining time hidden
renders.lua:
A_Admin.SetCasting(635,"Holy Light","Interface\\Icons\\Spell_Holy_HolyBolt",2.5)
local clock = C_DurationUtil.CreateManualClock(1)
local duration = C_DurationUtil.CreateDuration()
duration:SetClock(clock)
duration:SetTimeFromStart(0,2.5)
local reader = UnitCastingDuration
UnitCastingDuration = function(unit) if unit == "player" then return duration end return reader(unit) end
A_Admin.FireEvent("UNIT_SPELLCAST_START","player")
RikRenderCenter(RikUICast_player,2)
for _, option in ipairs(RikUI.CastBars.Options.settings) do if option.key == "timeText" then option.set(false) end end

renders.title: Inventory and item stacks
renders.lua:
RikRenderItems()
RikUIBags:Show()
RikUI.Bags.Refresh()
RikRenderCenter(RikUIBags)
assert(RikUIBag0Slot2.rikIcon:GetTexture() == 134829, "Wrong potion icon")
assert(RikUIBag0Slot2.rikCount:GetText() == "5", "Missing stack count")
renders.assertLua:
local left, right = RikUIBags.search:GetTextInsets()
assert(left == 16 and right == 20, "Search text must clear its icon and button")
assert(RikUIBags.bagHint:GetWidth() > 100, "Multiline label must fit its longest line")
